points.heading: Deepen: two-word times
points.body:
Today only the two-word path: helper haber + participle (-ado/-ido), the already-done form.

Let's explore together. Listen to the same participle with different helpers: he cantado, había cantado, habré cantado, habría cantado. The participle stays; the helper moves.

Practice: Now it's your turn. With participle comido, write he / habías / habremos / habría + comido. Mark helper and participle, then invent one real-life sentence with he comido.

Common mistake: Hemos comidos → hemos comido.

lesson.summary: This lesson teaches practice two-word times. Understand the central idea first, then explore it, practice it, and check a common mistake.

Why should «comido» stay the same in «hemos comido»?
choices: The participle does not become plural for the subject.
It is always a future word.
